name: gemworks
description: A workbench right beside your agent chat: it keeps your artifacts in order, sums up what you've learned, remembers what you've decided, and lets your workflow grow on its own. In Codex, the work items, artifacts and flows are on a GEML board page.

interface.shortDescription: A workbench right beside your agent chat.
interface.longDescription: Gemworks keeps a project's progress, artifacts and lessons beside the chat. The model reports work items, practices and artifacts through its MCP tools; with this plugin's hooks trusted (/hooks), each turn brings back the work items on the way, the current step's practices and what other sessions decided. Everything is written to a GEML board page, .geml/board.geml, which the GEML extension for VS Code-style editors previews beside your code. A strict flow can also limit which tools each stage may use; a transition that needs your approval waits for `gemworks advance` in a terminal.
defaultPrompt: Read the current stage with status, then do what it asks.
Run the tests, then call status: did the workflow move on?
